text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock C at a profit felt rewarding, but my cost basis and the pleasure of locking in gains should not decide whether I sell; I should weigh each stock’s outlook and my portfolio allocation.","I sold Stock B several times as it rose, then later added to several positions. I should make each trade for a clear portfolio reason rather than repeatedly trimming winners or buying simply because cash is available.","My account value fluctuated even when I did nothing, and it was higher by Period 10 than Period 1. I should judge progress over time, keep risk diversified, and avoid reacting to every monthly move."]}
